title.justification: This is the title of the paper.

extractions.description: The paper introduces a gold-standard set of dependency parses for Compositional Freebase Queries (CFQ) to analyze the behavior of a state-of-the-art dependency parser on the CFQ dataset. It finds that increasing compound divergence degrades dependency parsing performance, and identifies syntactic structures that drive the dependency parser’s lower performance on the most challenging splits.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper focuses on improving NLP models and doesn't directly address sustainable development themes.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: This article contributes to compositional generalization research, a foundational concern for neural natural natural language processing models. Break-throughs in this research might eventually lead to smaller, and more efficient models, as well as bet- ter performance on low-resource languages. The ethical and societal consequences of these improve- ments will depend on downstream applications.
